svg.desc: Gates G0 to G7 with the selected tasks due at each
svg.text: Figure 2 · Lifecycle gates and the MIL-STD-882E tasks due at each
The 8 project-defined gates with their Table A-I acquisition phase and the 19 selected tasks due at each, coloured by task record status. Current gate G0; a
gate passes only on a named human review.

Generated by tools/figures/framework_readme.py from the framework pages, the MIL-STD-882E tailoring and task records. Project-defined framework; no gate has passed and no compliance is claimed. Conditional, not-selected
and not-applicable tasks are on the task applicability page.

g.text: Terms: DoD = US Department of Defense · ECP = engineering change proposal · EMD = engineering and manufacturing development (acquisition phase) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) ·

MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · MSA = materiel solution analysis (acquisition phase) · OS = operations and support (acquisition phase) · PD = production and
deployment (acquisition phase) · TD = technology development (acquisition phase) · US = United States
